info.title: CarbonSynq Enhanced University Scope 1/2 API
info.description: Additional operations in the existing /api/v2 service. Existing authentication, Scope 1/2, private evidence and infrastructure operations remain in /openapi.json. New definitions and factors are not measurements. No AI provider, regulatory certification or production capacity claim. Decimal inputs are strings. Domain validation additionally enforces roles, relationships, current versions, date boundaries and conditional evidence. All database integration checks must pass in staging before production. Enhanced Scope 1/2 routes use independently approved period boundaries and a mutually exclusive source ledger. Location and market totals are alternatives; no numeric emission factors are supplied.
